params.token: Address of the ERC20 token to approve (e.g. USDC)

params._platform: The address that will manage the factory and receive fees

params.maxFeeBps: The highest fee the buyer is willing to accept, in basis points.                   This protects against frontrunning: if the platform raises the fee                   between when the buyer loaded the page and when the transaction is                   mined, the transaction reverts instead of silently charging more.
params.metadataHash: Hash of off-chain project details (stored cheaply on-chain)
params.milestoneAmounts: Array of payment amounts, one per milestone
params.seller: Who will receive payment (the service provider)
params.token: Which token to pay with — must be on the approved whitelist

returns.escrow: Address of the newly deployed escrow contract

getAllEscrows().details: Useful for admin dashboards. Note: the list only grows — escrows are never removed,      even if they are cancelled or completed.

getEscrowCount().details: Cheaper than getAllEscrows() if you only need the count, not the full list

getEscrowsByBuyer(address).details: Returns an empty array if the buyer has never created an escrow (no revert)

getEscrowsBySeller(address).details: Returns an empty array if the seller has never been part of an escrow

params.token: Address of the ERC20 token to remove

params.newDays: Must be between MIN_AUTO_APPROVAL_DAYS and MAX_AUTO_APPROVAL_DAYS
Must be between 0 and MAX_CORRECTION_WINDOW_DAYS (0 = admin resolves immediately)
Must be between MIN_DISPUTE_TIMEOUT_DAYS and MAX_DISPUTE_TIMEOUT_DAYS

params.newFeeBps: New fee in basis points — max 1000 (= 10%)

MAX_CORRECTION_WINDOW_DAYS().notice: Correction window can be 0 (disabled, admin resolves immediately) up to 30 days

MAX_FEE_BPS().notice: Maximum platform fee allowed: 10% (1000 basis points)

MAX_MILESTONES().notice: Maximum number of milestones per escrow

MIN_AUTO_APPROVAL_DAYS().notice: Auto-approval period must be between 1 and 90 days

MIN_DISPUTE_TIMEOUT_DAYS().notice: Dispute timeout must be between 14 and 180 days

PLATFORM().notice: The platform address — can manage tokens, change fees, and receive fees

approveToken(address).notice: Adds a token to the approved payment whitelist

approvedTokens(address).notice: Which tokens buyers are allowed to pay with (e.g. USDC)

constructor.notice: Sets up the factory with the platform address and default settings

createEscrow(address,address,uint256[],b.notice: Creates a new escrow contract for a project

defaultAutoApprovalDays().notice: How many days before a submitted milestone is auto-approved (default: 14)

defaultCorrectionWindowDays().notice: How many days the seller has to resubmit after a buyer-opened dispute (default: 0)

defaultDisputeTimeoutDays().notice: How many days before a dispute can be claimed as timed out (default: 30)

getAllEscrows().notice: Returns every escrow contract ever created by this factory

getEscrowCount().notice: Returns the total number of escrows ever created

getEscrowsByBuyer(address).notice: Returns all escrows created by a specific buyer

getEscrowsBySeller(address).notice: Returns all escrows a specific seller is part of

isValidEscrow(address).notice: Quick lookup: is this address a real escrow created by this factory?

platformFeeBps().notice: Current platform fee in basis points (250 = 2.5%)

removeToken(address).notice: Removes a token from the approved payment whitelist

setDefaultAutoApprovalDays(uint256).notice: Updates how many days before a submitted milestone is auto-approved

setDefaultCorrectionWindowDays(uint256).notice: Updates how many days the seller has to resubmit after a buyer-opened dispute

setDefaultDisputeTimeoutDays(uint256).notice: Updates how many days before a dispute can be claimed as timed out
